Gullyverse — consolidated Rev15O handoff

11 November 2026 • CODEX • WORLD-REV15O-CONSOLIDATED-20261111-2c78b57e-R1

This reconciles the shared recovery-control document, whose latest entry was Rev15I on 5 November, with the recovered source, the user's subsequent requests and the verified Rev15J–Rev15O reports. The earlier entries remain historical records. This handoff updates documentation; it does not start another art phase.

Current resume point

Use reports/house-railings-rev15o-ground-level-2026-11-11/delivery/Gullyverse-Rev15O-Clear-Ground-House-Fronts.blend for further whole-environment work. Active scene: REV15O / Clear Ground-Level House Fronts. The packed master is 171,581,117 bytes, contains 45 scenes and has no linked libraries. SHA-256: 2c78b57e97a5a97683f946d60ad265b22a1eb88ae12abed6220ec268ce473657.

The current independent carousel controller is REV15O / Team Carousel Controller; set its team_index custom property from 0 to 7. Index 0 is Organising Committee. Older previews/scripts may target earlier controllers; use this controller when resuming the current scene.

Repository: Divyansh-0909/Breeze-2027, branch work-in-progress-2027, HEAD 0e1e23dd2f5181df202d862d147067249bc55a41. This work changes the native Blender environment and private review previews. The public website, including the older /team page, has not been integrated with these changes. No commit, push, merge or deployment was performed.

Recovery and Team carousel — Rev15I1, J and J1

The recovered Rev15I1 master contained wider Organising Committee labels, but the prior Coordinator-removal request had no completed checkpoint. I1 was recovered from six Drive parts; its 141,815,521-byte master has SHA-256 07650da781f0ec7ff4e91b6725a9e45de8a55ae4fee8175e539b45bb2cb203b7. It remains a historical source.

Rev15J removed Coordinators from the active carousel, made Organising Committee the first slide and left eight active teams. It also matched the earlier supplied concrete-wall reference and produced laptop reviews. The nine-slide, Coordinator-first Rev15H/I state is superseded for current work; its source scenes and backups remain preserved. J retained 39 scenes.

Rev15J1 expanded “OC” to the full heading “Organising Committee” and retained 40 scenes. Later Rev15K supersedes the earlier concrete finish and title placement on the Team mural wall.

Team murals — Rev15K, retained in O

The Team wall uses worn running-bond brick painted black, with visible mortar, wear and relief. The shared brick substrate uses 2.48 m world mapping and 0.007 bump strength. There are eight active mural slides and 19 portraits, ordered: Organising Committee, Content, Design, Marketing, Public Relations, Sponsorship, Videography and Web Development.

Single-word team titles use one large foreground line, following the Content reference. Two-word titles use two stacked lines, following the Organising Committee reference. Portraits overlap behind the title while faces remain clear. Two-person teams use left/right placement; the four-person Organising Committee uses higher central portraits and lower outside portraits; the three-person Videography team uses left, right and top-centre placement.

Cream handwritten names, roles and arrows sit beside the faces. Organising Committee labels retain the real supplied identities and roles: Kushagr Saigal — Chairperson; Anubhav Kansal — Co-Chairperson; Rahul Rathnavel — Administrator; Ayushi — Administrator. Other teams use Lead. The names shown in the supplied style-reference image are layout examples, not replacement identities. Rev15K retained 41 scenes.

Graffiti and underground hip-hop references were research for lettering and composition. They did not create a separate destination or change the retained portrait identities.

Navigation and sponsor LED — Rev15L and L1, retained in O

Aftermovie is now the top direction beneath the Gullyverse branding, pointing up. Events points left and Team points right; Contact Us remains. The old bottom Aftermovie position is a non-directional “Past Sponsors” plaque. A black-cased amber/red dot-matrix LED hangs closely beneath it, with a 6 cm gap.

The LED scrolls the 62 unique sponsor marks from the current branch's public/images/sponsors and public/spons-image assets. The user identified these as last year's sponsors; no new sponsors or logos were invented. The native scene and private preview use the same continuous leftward loop. The frame extends 1.7 m upward, leaving a conservative 2.154 m walkway clearance. L retained 42 scenes.

At the user's request, L1 increased the nominal blank space between marks from 24 to 72 LED cells, three times the former gap. Logo artwork, fitted size and speed remain unchanged: 30 cells/second, a 10,676-cell period, approximately 355.87 seconds per loop at 30 fps. Pause and reduced-motion handling remain available in the private preview. L1 retains 42 scenes.

Pending navigation decision: Schedule still appears in the current asset as a placeholder, although the user rejected it as too similar to Events. Graffiti Yard was also rejected as insufficiently useful. Festival Guide (map, entry information, transport, parking and facilities) was suggested only; the user has not selected it and it has not been implemented. Do not report any replacement destination as complete or silently choose one.

Consistent crowd — Rev15M, retained in O

Nine auxiliary mannequins—three on the approach lane and six around the cypher—were replaced with the existing native Rev13A/Aftermovie crowd models, matching the user's requested crowd style. These are not the previously rejected website Man.glb/Animated-Woman.glb assets.

The replacements use nine wardrobes and six poses: relaxed, one hand in pocket, folded arms, hands together, weight shift and phone recording. Their XY anchors and standing heights remain; only their feet were lowered 9 cm to meet the actual ramp/roof surface. No additional 7% scaling or scatter was applied. The original 180 audience members are unchanged, giving 189 people overall. M retained 43 scenes.

Events on the existing cypher house — Rev15N, retained in O

Events now uses the inward-facing lower façade of the existing L2 house beside the cypher. Its worn brick is warm grey/taupe, using the same substrate scale and relief as the Team wall with a non-black colour ramp. No new wall was added. The original house mesh coordinates and topology are unchanged.

The separate plaster display, foot skirting and five battens were removed. Eight existing event posters are mounted on solid wall piers in two rows at 0.78 uniform scale, leaving a clear central EVENTS heading. Doors, windows, shutters, beams and upper floors remain. The existing display lamp moved to the beam with its power, colour and orientation preserved; global lighting and the five locked-off optional shop support lights remain unchanged. N retained 44 scenes.

N still had ground-level rails when reviewed. Their later removal in O is the current state.

Ground-level house railings — Rev15O

The low guardrails at L2/Events, R1, R3 and B2 have been removed from the walkable courtyard level. The edit removes 204 connected metal pieces spanning Z7.376–8.344 m beside the Z7.2 m floor. Upper balcony railings remain.

Only four combined railing meshes received independent edited copies. Every retained metal face, material and smooth flag matches its original canonical checksum. Structural posts, beams, slabs, doors, windows, shutters, window hardware and poster frames remain. O retains the Events warm brick wall, all 189 people, eight Team murals and the wider sponsor-logo loop. It includes all 44 earlier scene memberships plus the new current scene, for 45 scenes.

Reviews, backup evidence and limits

Each J, J1, K, L, L1, M, N and O milestone has a separate Drive checkpoint with source, reviews and verification evidence. Their direct links follow in the shared document and artifact index. The earlier 52-view full-environment PDF is a historical inspection baseline, not an all-world render of the latest O scene.

The O backup consists of eight ZIP parts, a 181,887,272-byte archive and 36 payload files. All 15 uploads passed authenticated download-back SHA-256, remote size and parent checks. Every archived payload passed CRC/size/SHA checks when read from the downloaded part stream. The current master was separately opened in a fresh Blender process and reported 45 scenes. This is streamed archive verification, not a claim that O received another independent full extraction; earlier K/L records separately document their extraction/restore checks.

To restore O, download all eight parts plus INDEX.json, SHA256SUMS.txt and restore.py from its checkpoint, follow the packaged instructions and verify the master hash above. Earlier remote backups remain intact. Local temporary packaging/download copies were cleaned only after remote verification; the remote parts are the restoration source. This documentation phase reuses the verified O art checkpoint and adds separate before/after native Doc copies and a small documentation checkpoint.

The user said “good” after the railing change and then requested this document update. Record acceptance of that direction for continuation, without inventing blanket approval of portrait likeness, runtime integration, device performance or production release. Preserve the earlier Rev12 architecture and Rev13A crowd approvals and the existing LAST_CHATGPT_REVIEWED_HANDOFF_ID; this documentation update does not fabricate a new independent ChatGPT review.

Historic scooter approaches, six non-public rear lightwell misses and an unidentified rack/table are not newly resolved by these edits. Further art, the unresolved navigation destination and website integration await the user's next request. No automatic next phase is started by this entry.
